cohort: The study included 7256 first parity singleton very preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks gestational age, admitted to NICUs participating in the Chinese Neonatal Network between 2019 and 2021.
finding: Maternal abortion history was significantly associated with higher risks of mortality or any major morbidity, RDS, IVH, and severe IVH, with risks increasing with the number of previous abortions.
